### tool/vocabulary/corpus/b08/answers/census-form.txt ### Review and Submit
state people=[{"id":1,"name":"Maria Alvarez","dob":"14 Mar 1984","activity":"Working for an employer"},{"id":2,"name":"Tomas Alvarez","dob":"02 Aug 2012","activity":"Student"}]
state submitted=false
state ref=""
state confirmed=false
Page
  Nav
    Brand "Headcount" icon="groups"
    Text.muted "Code {code}"
  Section
    Column gap=20
      if !submitted
        Heading "Review your answers" level=1
        Text.muted "Check each person before you submit. You cannot change answers afterwards."
        Card gap=0
          Row pad=12 border-bottom=#FFE0E0E0
            Text.strong "Name" grow
            Text.strong "Date of birth" w=140 hide=phone
            Text.strong "Main activity" w=220 hide=tablet
            Text.strong "" w=60
          each p in people
            Row pad=12 border-bottom=#FFE0E0E0
              Text "{p.name}" grow
              Text "{p.dob}" w=140 hide=phone
              Text "{p.activity}" w=220 hide=tablet
              Link "Edit" w=60 onTap={sel=p.id; go question}
        Checkbox "I confirm these answers are correct to the best of my knowledge" @confirmed
        Row between
          Button.outline "Back" onTap={go household}
          Button "Submit census" size=large disabled={!confirmed} onTap={ref="HC-" + upper(replace(code,"-","")) + "-" + length(people); submitted=true; emit submit ref}
      if submitted
        Column gap=16 center animate=pop
          IconTile "check_circle"
          Heading "Thank you, your census is submitted" level=1
          Text.muted "Your reference number is"
          Text.mono "{ref}" size=28 weight=700
          Row gap=8
            Button.outline "Copy reference" onTap={copy ref; toast "Copied"}
            Button "Done" onTap={go start}

### tool/vocabulary/corpus/b07/answers/outliner-notes.txt ### Outline
state nodes=[{"id":"n1","parent":"","text":"Q4 planning","done":false,"folded":false,"task":false},{"id":"n2","parent":"n1","text":"Hiring plan #hiring","done":false,"folded":false,"task":false},{"id":"n3","parent":"n2","text":"Open two backend roles","done":false,"folded":false,"task":true},{"id":"n4","parent":"n2","text":"Review intern pipeline with [[Mara Okafor]]","done":true,"folded":false,"task":true},{"id":"n5","parent":"n1","text":"Launch checklist #launch","done":false,"folded":true,"task":false},{"id":"n6","parent":"n5","text":"Freeze copy on Nov 3","done":false,"folded":false,"task":true},{"id":"n7","parent":"","text":"Reading list","done":false,"folded":false,"task":false},{"id":"n8","parent":"n7","text":"A Pattern Language, chapter on thresholds","done":false,"folded":false,"task":false}]
state focus=""
state tasksMode=false
state hideDone=false
state tag=""
state sel=""
state note="Q4 planning"
state q=""
App
  Sidebar
    Brand "Indent" icon="format_list_bulleted"
    NavItem "Home" icon="home" selected={focus==""} onTap={focus=""; go outline}
    NavItem "Daily notes" icon="today" onTap={go daily-notes}
    NavItem "Search" icon="search" onTap={open search}
    Divider
    Text.caption "Tags"
    NavItem "#hiring" icon="tag" badge="3" selected={tag=="hiring"} onTap={tag="hiring"; go tag-page}
    NavItem "#launch" icon="tag" badge="5" selected={tag=="launch"} onTap={tag="launch"; go tag-page}
    NavItem "#reading" icon="tag" badge="2" onTap={tag="reading"; go tag-page}
    Spacer grow
    Text.muted "1,284 bullets"
  Main
    Nav
      Row gap=4 middle
        Link "Home" onTap={focus=""}
        Icon "chevron_right"
        Link "Q4 planning" visible={focus!=""} onTap={focus="n1"}
        Icon "chevron_right" visible={focus=="n2"}
        Text.strong "{coalesce(find(nodes,x=>x.id==focus).text,'Home')}"
      Row gap=8
        IconButton "search" tooltip="Quick search (Ctrl+K)" onTap={open search}
        Toggle "Tasks" @tasksMode
        IconButton "more_horiz" tooltip="Page options" onTap={open pageMenu}
    Column pad=24 gap=16 maxw=720
      Text.pageTitle "{focus=='' ? 'Home' : find(nodes,x=>x.id==focus).text}"
      Row gap=8
        Chip "Expand all" onTap={fold all false}
        Chip "Collapse all" onTap={fold all true}
        FilterChip "Hide completed" selected={hideDone} onTap={hideDone=!hideDone}
      Outline @nodes focus={focus} tasks={tasksMode} hideDone={hideDone} placeholder="Type to add a bullet" onFocusNode={focus=result.id} onEdit={nodes=updateWhere(nodes,x=>x.id==result.id,x=>with(x,"text",result.text))} onEnter={addAfter result.id} onIndent={indent result.id} onOutdent={outdent result.id} onFold={nodes=updateWhere(nodes,x=>x.id==result.id,x=>with(x,"folded",!x.folded))} onToggleDone={nodes=updateWhere(nodes,x=>x.id==result.id,x=>with(x,"done",!x.done))} onMove={move result.id result.to} onTagTap={tag=result.tag; go tag-page} onLinkTap={focus=result.id} onContext={sel=result.id; open bulletMenu} menu=bulletMenu
      Divider
      Text.sectionTitle "Linked references"
      Text.muted "Bullets that mention this page."
      each ref in filter(nodes,x=>contains(x.text,"[[Mara Okafor]]"))
        Card gap=4 onTap={focus=ref.id}
          Text.caption "Q4 planning / Hiring plan"
          Text "{ref.text}"
  Menu#bulletMenu
    MenuItem "Focus on this bullet" icon="my_location" onTap={focus=sel}
    MenuItem "Make a task" icon="check_box" onTap={nodes=updateWhere(nodes,x=>x.id==sel,x=>with(x,"task",!x.task))}
    MenuItem "Indent" icon="format_indent_increase" onTap={indent sel}
    MenuItem "Outdent" icon="format_indent_decrease" onTap={outdent sel}
    MenuItem "Copy link" icon="link" onTap={copy "indent://{sel}"; toast "Link copied"}
    MenuItem "Delete" icon="delete" onTap={nodes=removeWhere(nodes,x=>x.id==sel); toast "Bullet deleted"}
  Menu#pageMenu end
    MenuItem "Export as Markdown" icon="download" onTap={emit export}
    MenuItem "Copy page link" icon="link" onTap={copy "indent://{focus}"; toast "Copied"}
  Dialog#search "Quick search" "Jump to any bullet, page or tag"
    Input "Search" "Type to search" @q autofocus
    Column gap=4
      each hit in take(filter(nodes,x=>contains(lower(x.text),lower(q))),8)
        ListTile "{hit.text}" onTap={focus=hit.id; close}
    Text.muted "Ctrl+K opens this from anywhere"
